- **Story:** As Ari, a model that has never seen Phrase, I want to complete the guide using only its text, so that the guide is usable by an AI agent as well as by a person.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the card 137 runner, When it is pointed at the guide as the only documentation, Then Codex completes the guide's steps (reaches a running API that answers its first request) in one attempt, and the totals-only result is recorded
  2. Given a failure, When a model gets stuck, Then the stuck step is recorded as a finding for the guide, not as a defect of the runner
  3. Given the result file, When it is read, Then it holds totals only (no reply text)
